source.classification: Owner-supplied text extraction of 2011 dealer catalog indexes; underlying 144-page scan not independently rechecked

limits: This is a watch-size/weight and model/module index extraction, not every pictured colourway or retail SKU.
311 watch rows represent 310 unique base identifiers: SDB-100J is printed twice for two suffix/weight groups. Those are retained without inventing retail SKUs or selecting one weight.
109 clock entries are indexed separately; no clock dimensions, weight, module or functions are inferred.
Indexed dimensions and mass are printed family/base-label values, not automatically the dimensions of every unlisted colour, band or regional variant.
Only legible module numbers from the supplied cross-check are retained. Multi-module rows remain alternatives at index scope, not a fitted-module determination.
A dash means not reliably established by this extraction, not absence or zero. No functional features are filled from model similarity.
Printed extraction group headings are preserved as source grouping, not independently validated manufacturer classification.
Original product PDF page = printed catalog page + 2. Watch-size table: original PDF142 / printed140; module index: original PDF143 / printed141.
2011 is the catalog year, not a model release date. Underlying 144-page scan has not been independently rechecked here.
All selected facts remain pending source review. No original scanned pages, catalog artwork or photographs are distributed.
